reviews.text: I would like to thank Doug and Ryan with Outdoor Living Pool and Patio for doing such an amazing job! Our pool, outdoor kitchen, and putting green turned out exactly as we had hoped—absolutely stunning. Their professionalism, attention to detail, and dedication made the entire process smooth and enjoyable. We couldn’t be happier with the final result and highly recommend them to anyone looking to transform their outdoor space.
reviews.author: Jay T

reviews.text: I just had a pool and spa built by Outdoor Living and couldn’t be happier!  Clint was wonderful to work with during the sales and design process and helped me get exactly what I wanted but still stayed within my budget.  Cindy was wonderful at keeping me updated on the steps of the process and Tony oversaw the build and was great to work with.  My questions were always answered and my concerns were addressed promptly.  I would highly recommend this amazing team of people.
reviews.author: Elizabeth Martin

reviews.text: It was a pleasure working with Doug. He did an awesome job guiding us from start to finish, beginning with pool design all the way to project finalization. Doug has been available when we needed him and managed the project through several unexpected obstacles. Thank you to the whole Outdoor Living Pool and Patio team for putting our dream into reality. We are looking forward to enjoy our backyard oasis for years to come.
reviews.author: Michael Bierstedt

reviews.text: After looking at multiple companies we decided to with Outdoor Living Pool & Patio to extend out our patio space.  The whole prcoess went smooth from the initial talks with Clint to the build experience with Cody.  Cody was very responsive throughout the build process and came by the house muiltiple times to ensure the contractors were doing the job correctly.  Both Cody and Clint were very patient with our numerous questions and made sure that everything was perfect for us.  This project turned out even better than we could have expected.  We will be enjoying this outdoor space for years to come!  Thank you guys!
reviews.author: Ashdon Ayling

reviews.text:
*****Buyer beware*****

I don’t even know where to begin but If you want to save yourself a giant headache, very costly repairs and a terribly built pool/deck, look elsewhere. We had a pool built by Outdoor Living Pool and Patio in 2022 and we have  had nothing but problems and terrible communication the entire time. Multiple meetings with Tanner (sales consultant), James (project manager), Lance (the owner) and eventually Collie, not a single one of them would follow through with anything that they said they would do. It obviously starts from the top down.  We have every email, text and phone call logged. After the pool was “completed” we started filling it with water and noticed lots of calcium buildup on the tile wall immediately, James was taking care of all of the chemicals at this point and said it would be cleaned once everything was balanced. It was never removed after asking multiple times. We have a very reputable pool care company taking care of our pool and they told us it was never “sealed”. They/we have worked very hard to remove the calcium and it will not come off, the tile is ruined. The travertine coping had pieces filled in with a putty that eventually (6m -1yr) broke off and is now sharp around the tanning ledge. Our concrete decking looks terrible, it has cracked so bad that it has now busted a pipe, causing our pool to leak.  We reported the cracking 6 months after the pool was built and they told us it was “ground movement” bc that is not covered under warranty. We have a VERY hard time believing it’s ground movement considering we had a separate deck poured by another company and it looks great, not a single crack anywhere.  We are missing a valve that separates the bubblers and waterfalls. Again, no one will come install it after asking for months/years. The owner himself has admitted these items should be fixed/added/repaired but nothing has been done. After contacting a lawyer, ironically the company name is not the name on file with the state, meaning, the company does this to hide any pending litigation. Through this legal process we have found others in the same situation. Same exact sales consultant, same project manager, same pool design, same problems.  Sadly due to the mediation clause in the contract, the findings will never be made public.  We regret daily not going with BMR. We have several friends that have used them and rave about the customer service and their pools are beautiful!
reviews.author: Amy Pugh

reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of working with a top class team. Starting from the initial design phase, BJ mapped out our backyard to spec and hit every point we wanted given the limited space we had. I had 4-5 companies trying to secure the bid and outdoor living was the most professional, prepared, and best when it came to competitive pricing.

James was assigned as our Project Manager and was very responsive and helpful when dealing with standard project roadblocks a long the way. He was informative and always worked to resolve all concerns we had. He always took the time to explain a process that was new to us.

Collie was also on site as the relationship manager with his goal of putting the customer first. We had a few things we ran into such as loss of two trees during the dig and some minor impacts during the build. He fixed everything we asked and always delivered on his word. He also always took our calls and was thorough in explaining the final steps in resolving remaining actions prior to sign off of last payment.

Lastly, after final payment was administered the process was handed off to their warranty team for any questions/concerns. This is our first pool and we are still learning as we go. Tony has been instrumental in explaining plumbing and how things operate in different modes. He has taken all our calls, came out to site to explain the pool chiller in more detail, and has FaceTimed assisting beyond office hours when he didn’t have to. Thank you for the awesome experience and pool. Our family loves it and would definitely use them again in a future home.
reviews.author: Blake “Blake B” Bogard

reviews.text: After doing our due diligence and sitting down with other pool builders we decided to go with OLP&P. They were the most competitively priced company and they were straight forward with our wants and the project. There were only a few tiny communication issues during the building process where we felt out of the loop, but we were able to get the info and reassurance within 24hrs. I can’t recall any major issues at all and definitely think of them as a solid pool builder and company and one that I would highly recommend.
reviews.author: antonjuan miller

data.summary: The Google reviews (314) appear highly authentic with specific, varied praise. The significant rating discrepancies with Houzz and Angi are concerning but based on very low review volumes (1 and 18). The lack of accessible negative review text makes it impossible to evaluate complaint credibility or patterns. The strong, detailed Google profile suggests a generally reputable contractor with possible isolated service issues.
fake_signals: No Yelp reviews found to cross-reference
Limited negative review data from Houzz/Angi to analyze patterns
authentic_signals: Google reviews contain specific employee names (Doug, Ryan, Clint, Cindy, Tony, Cody) and project details (pools, spas, kitchens, putting greens)
Varied writing styles and perspectives in Google reviews
Long-term positive update from a customer ('2 yrs later and everything is good')
BBB A+ accreditation and no complaints listed
complaint_patterns: Potential communication/scheduling issues (inferred from lower Angi rating)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating discrepancy between Google (4.5/314 reviews) and Houzz (1.0/1 review). Angi rating (3.7/18) is also notably lower than Google. This suggests potential platform-specific issues or a very small, negative sample on Houzz/Angi.
